topic: Documenting frame status visibility on traffic page
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the need to update documentation regarding how various frame and campaign statuses affect visibility within analytics reports, specifically the traffic board.

Currently, while campaign status changes are documented (with a note that nothing is hidden), there is no clear guidance or documentation stating whether frames are hidden from the traffic page based on their status. A specific concern was raised about the 'Changed' status and how it impacts visibility, particularly for operational teams who frequently ask about it.

It was confirmed that currently, frames are not hidden on the traffic page regardless of their status (even if marked as Demolished). However, inactive facilities are only visually marked in filters.
decisions: The documentation needs an update to explicitly state whether frames are visible or invisible on the traffic board for every defined status.
action_items: [p5] will add a note confirming that frames are not hidden on the traffic page, although this task has been delayed.
The team needs to schedule time to update documentation regarding frame visibility across all statuses and reports.
